units.what: Electrolytes: Consult a doctor if you have kidney disease or heart conditions.
Never combine Iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds).
Behavioral Warning (The Isolation Trap): While this protocol demands starving the brain of "Phasic" Dopamine (excitement, novelty, the chase), do not isolate completely.
Avoid "Exciting Love" (romance, high-stakes drama), as this spikes Phasic Dopamine and resets the armor.
Cognitive Warning: As you de-armor, you will feel naked and exposed.
Rule: During this protocol, do not trust your social intuition.
Agmatine Warning (The Voltage Governor): Agmatine is not a basic nutrient like magnesium or a membrane nutrient like phosphatidylcholine.

Do not combine agmatine casually with opioids, kratom, clonidine/guanfacine, blood-pressure medication, nitrates, PDE-5 inhibitors, MAOIs, or complex psychiatric medication stacks without clinician review.

Avoid it during pregnancy or breastfeeding, and be especially cautious with bipolar disorder, psychosis history, unstable panic, low blood pressure, kidney/liver disease, or active substance relapse risk.
Stop immediately if it causes flatness, anhedonia, emotional blunting, new depression, agitation, insomnia, dizziness, palpitations, nausea, loose stools, diarrhea, or increased craving.
Do not "push through" numbness.

Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These are not "trip enhancers." They are repair-oriented levers that can change brain sensitivity quickly. 5-HTP is serotonergic because it is a direct serotonin precursor.
Do not combine it with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St.
John's wort, SAM-e, L-tryptophan, or other serotonin-raising stacks without clinician review.

Be especially conservative around ayahuasca / harmalas because MAO-A inhibition can amplify serotonin load, and around iboga / ibogaine because ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport biology and already carry serious cardiac and neurological risk.
Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as psychedelics, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga unless the whole medicine plan has been medically reviewed.
Do not take UMP on the same day as psychedelics; if sensitivity changes, assume your old psychedelic dose may now be too high.
The science behind this protocol focuses on four specific neuro-biological mechanisms that must be addressed before psychological tools can be effective.
You must aggressively engineer a "High-Density" social environment (A Tribe), or the brain will eventually reach for the armor again just to survive the cold.
Before applying the tools, you must understand the specific "Hardware Failures" that occur during trauma, withdrawal, or chronic stress.
The Lock (Zinc/Magnesium): Physically blocks the receptor channel to stop the voltage.

The Repair (Leucine/L-Serine): L-Serine acts as a precursor to D-Serine to recalibrate the GluD 'Volume Dial' to enhance therapeutic sessions that end with low fear/high mastery (although conversion to D-serine is inefficient, which is why some people use D-serine itself which has higher risk/benefit).
Important conflict: do not use agmatine as a same-session companion to D-Serine/DCS-style exposure or EMDR work.
Why don't these drugs work on calcified PTSD?
Double click to interact with video
The Goal: You must do this for 10-20 minutes immediately after a trigger to "jam" the memory reconsolidation.
(Don't lean on tuna daily - mercury.)
Don't raise the dose to push through - stop.
Do not confuse these three tools:
Who this is for: This is not for everyone with depression.
So the mechanism is plausible, but the DAWS use is still a cautious human extrapolation plus anecdote.
Do not start UMP on the same day you start 5-HTP, agmatine, D-serine, keto, iboga, shrooms, LSD, ketamine, or any other major variable.

Side effects / stop signs: The most common problem is the "choline headache" or spaced-out brain fog: if UMP accelerates membrane synthesis while choline availability is low, the system can feel under-supplied.
Other stop signs include insomnia, jitteriness, racing thoughts, irritability, emotional flatness, nausea, stomach cramps, or loose stools.
If it makes you wired, numb, or weirdly irritable, stop.
Do not push through.
Psychedelic caution: If UMP makes dreams vivid or suddenly lowers psychedelic tolerance, treat that as a safety signal.
Do not take UMP on psychedelic days.
Who this is for: This is for the low-serotonin-looking pattern, not for every depressed person.
A broad review of 5-HTP discusses its role in serotonin biology and its use in mood, anxiety, sleep, obesity, myoclonus, and serotonin-toxicity contexts.
Trial: Start lower if you are sensitive: 50 mg 5-HTP at night for 2-3 nights, then 100 mg only if the lower amount is clearly helpful and not activating.
Do not combine the trial with UMP, agmatine, D-serine, psychedelics, or medication changes.

Side effects / stop signs: Nausea, stomach discomfort, loose stools, headache, vivid or intense dreams, insomnia, sweating, tremor, anxiety, irritability, emotional agitation, or a too-bright / hypomanic feeling.
Stop immediately if you get agitation + sweating + diarrhea + tremor/clonus + fever, confusion, fast heart rate, or unstable blood pressure.
That pattern can indicate serotonin toxicity, which can become dangerous.
Hard interaction rule: 5-HTP should not be mixed casually with serotonin-raising drugs or supplements.
Case literature and clinical reviews warn about serotonin syndrome risk when 5-HTP is combined with antidepressants or MAOIs, and serotonin syndrome is most often a multi-drug / stack problem.
See the dietary supplement interaction case report and the general serotonin-syndrome overview from MedlinePlus.
For this readership: avoid 5-HTP on psychedelic days, and be especially strict around ayahuasca / harmala MAOI chemistry and iboga / ibogaine.
KETONE DECISION: You must choose your fuel strategy.
Do not rely on lean protein alone (chicken breast), or your body will convert the protein to sugar (Gluconeogenesis), keeping you out of ketosis.
To avoid side effects, refer to the Keto Adaptation Guide.
DO NOT load extra salt (Risk of High Blood Pressure).
The Science: Your neurons have "brakes" called KCNQ channels that stop them from firing uncontrollably.
You can push the pedal (breathe), but the car won't stop.
The Mandate: You must hit 4,700 mg of Potassium daily.
(Supplements are dangerous and limited to 99mg).
For this protocol, cap at 1 g/day unless clinician-supervised.
Poor fit: already numb, low-drive, depressed, dissociated, low blood pressure, sedated, or entering the Dynorphin Void.
Stop if flatness, anhedonia, apathy, irritability, insomnia, dizziness, nausea, loose stools, diarrhea, or increased craving appears.
Timing rule: avoid agmatine on D-Serine/DCS-style reconsolidation days, or keep it at least 12-24 hours away from the session.
Do not take it on psychedelic days.
Do not combine with serotonergic medications, ayahuasca/harmalas, iboga, MDMA, DXM, tramadol, or same-day psychedelics.
Warning: Direct D-Serine carries a higher renal (kidney) load than L-Serine.
Do not exceed 30mg/kg and ensure high water intake.
This risk is compounded by the higher renal load caused by a keto diet or high protein intake.
Mechanism: Hypometabolism (Low Fuel) or Toxicity (Static).
Do not start both together, and do not use either to force stronger psychedelic effects.
The Metabolic Red Line: If your resting heart rate is elevated or HRV reduced, do NOT use high heat yet.
Make sure to check all the dangerous iboga drug interactions.
No hot showers if heart rate elevated or heart-rate-variability reduced.
Phosphatidylserine 300-600 mg earlier in the day only if you fit the high-cortisol profile + 1 cup broccoli sprouts + Magnesium Glycinate 400 mg + NAC 1.8-2.4 g divided.
Optional add-on: Agmatine Sulfate 250-500 mg AM, increasing to 500 mg twice daily only if it clearly reduces the hot/itchy/reactive state without flattening mood.
Cap at 1 g/day in this protocol.
Do not add agmatine on the same day you increase PS, start D-Serine, change NAC dose, begin keto, microdose, or introduce any other major variable.
If PS leaves you flat OR more wired, you're not a high-cortisol responder - drop it.
If agmatine leaves you flat, anhedonic, dizzy, nauseous, sleepless, irritable, or more craving-prone - drop it.
Weeks 3-5: The Dynorphin Void (Depression Phase)State: The anxiety stops, but the world turns gray/boring.
This phase is low-drive and gray by design - you do not want to keep blunting cortisol in an already-flattened system, or you'll deepen the numbness.
(If you never felt the wired/high-cortisol state in Weeks 1-2, you probably shouldn't have been on PS at all.)
Also stop agmatine here unless it is unmistakably helping acute glutamate storms without worsening flatness.
Do not take UMP on psychedelic days, and assume old psychedelic doses may become too strong if sensitivity returns.
Do not use with serotonergic medications/supplements, ayahuasca/harmalas, iboga, MDMA, DXM, tramadol, or same-day psychedelics.
No hot showers if heart rate elevated or heart-rate-variability reduced.
Reduce or stop phosphatidylserine here - you don't want to suppress an already-flattened system.
For years, you have likely been numb-living in your head to avoid the pain in your chest.
Do not mistake this sensitivity for anxiety.
